cohort: Singleton births in women with psoriasis
finding: Women with psoriasis, particularly severe psoriasis, had an increased risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, elective and emergency cesarean delivery, pre-term birth, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Women with psoriasis had an increased risk of elective and emergency cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in babies born to mothers with psoriasis, particularly severe psoriasis
